intro: A signature piece of attire worn by members of the Defias Brotherhood across Westfall. Crafted from dyed crimson leather, it serves as both a practical face covering and an unmistakable symbol of defiance against the Crown of Stormwind.

p: Across the dusty fields and abandoned farms of Westfall, these crimson bandanas conceal the faces of highwaymen, looters, and rebellious laborers. To the People's Militia stationed at Sentinel Hill, the headwear is more than simple cloth—it is concrete proof of allegiance to Edwin VanCleef's rogue fraternity. Scout Galiaan collects these bandanas from passing adventurers to monitor the shifting movements and dwindling numbers of the brotherhood throughout the region.
